claim: In on-demand mode, Kinesis Data Streams monitors traffic for each shard; when the incoming traffic exceeds 500 KB/s per shard, it splits the shard within 15 minutes, and the parent shard's hash key values are redistributed evenly across the child shards.

evidence.quote: With the on-demand mode (same as with the provisioned capacity mode), you must specify a partition key with each record to write data into your data stream. Kinesis Data Streams uses your partition keys to distribute data across shards. Kinesis Data Streams monitors traffic for each shard. When the incoming traffic exceeds 500 KB/s per shard, it splits the shard within 15 minutes. The parent shard’s hash key values are redistributed evenly across child shards.
